name: Return skill
description: Every player knows 'Возвращение в город' (stock skill 2099 'Escape: 5 minutes', overridden): like a Scroll of Escape to the nearest town, but a 60 s cast, no scroll, 30 min reuse. Also: live players auto-learn their skills up to AutoLearnMaxLevel (19).

AutoLearnMaxLevel.description: Live players (never bots) learn every skill of their class automatically up to this level (on login and level up); 0 = off.
